column1: # Per-vector path-aware EDP -- RCA/CLA/TER EXHAUSTIVE sweeps, 2/4/8/12/16-bit.
# RCA/CLA: full 2^N x 2^N value sweep (unsigned 0..2^N-1 per operand), single
# continuous process at 2/4/8-bit (matches the established exhaustive_results.csv
# methodology exactly -- no forking, since forking into independent fresh-started
# workers breaks cross-vector correlation and was verified to change the total).
# 12/16-bit: auto-parallelized warm-start fork (each of hardware_concurrency() workers
# takes a contiguous A-value slice, first silently replaying the TRUE predecessor
# vector (a_start-1, max_B) to reach the exact circuit state a single continuous
# process would have at that point, before counting -- verified byte-exact against
# the single-process reference at 8/12-bit before being trusted at 16-bit).
# TER: FIXED 2026-11-04 to use the SAME unsigned 0..2^N-1 value range per operand as
# RCA/CLA at every width (dropped-NAF/TER-BIN encoding: each value's own plain binary
# bits as signed digits, never using the -1 digit state), via ter_2n_glitch_pathEDP.cpp.
# Previously, the TER-2/4/8 rows below used a DIFFERENT, inconsistent methodology (full
# 3^N x 3^N REDUNDANT signed-digit sweep, representing operand values over a signed,
# roughly -(2^N-1)..+(2^N-1) range -- see git history for the old numbers), while only
# TER-12/16 used the corrected unsigned range. All widths now use the same range and
# the same single-continuous-process methodology as RCA/CLA (TER-12/16 additionally
# auto-parallelize via the same warm-start fork
# For each vector: gate switches reset before that vector (switches_i = that vector's
# own switch count), delay_i = max real OpenSTA/Nangate45 delay among every (changed
# input pin, changed output pin) pair exercised by that specific transition. EDP_i =
# switches_i * delay_i, accumulated per vector, THEN averaged -- not avg_switches *
# avg_delay (naive/incorrect, shown alongside for comparison).
